title: FourCastNet: high-resolution global forecasts with neural networks
summary: The preprint presents global forecasts at 0.25° resolution and a one-week forecast in under two seconds. Comparison with IFS is favorable at short lead times for large-scale variables and some finer-scale variables; this does not mean general superiority or operational use.

evidence.tested: Forecasts at 0.25 degrees are compared with ECMWF IFS, matching it at short lead times for large-scale variables and outperforming it for some fine-scale variables such as precipitation.
evidence.unknown: Not reported in the arXiv abstract read.
evidence.ai_role: Adaptive Fourier neural operator produced global weather forecasts.
